verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires a panel-mounted momentary button and 2-pin JST-GH connector to control the AXP2101 PWRON signal for system power toggling.
The client moves the panel-button connector from the power board to the main board and specifies that it tap the PWRON line at J_PWR_SIG pin 4.
The source accepts general connector placement flexibility on the integrated board but does not specifically move or modify the panel power-control connector.
